design_assessment.assessment: Existing two-PNG authoring lifecycle remains one owner for strict profile validation, shared decode/crop/nearest/pixelOver, source rechecks and exclusive publication. Three finite presentations are data, not per-script handlers. Captioned masks control fixed native-size composition before whole-canvas scale; flat geometry forces both crops to before extent and scales source-space gap. No duplicated decoder, resampler, font backend or writer.

The one Opaque method is justified by stdlib PNG RGB/RGBA selection. Embedded NRGBA retains pixels while forcing flat wire type6, avoiding a custom encoder; measured flat bytes have opaque alpha but preserve RGBA mode. Default checker and weekday retain type2.

Typed canonical-key/non-null JSON, layout/font compatibility guards, bounded source/crop/canvas/font work, and all-input rechecks are cohesive. Fixed embedded layout invariants are not exposed as unbounded profile switches. Resize/font kernels and old policies remain byte-identical to accepted contacts baseline.
